SfxItemPropertySet static/named value and state helpers now use actual property maps, deep item pointers, real pool defaults and Any/QueryValue/PutValue/enum normalization. GetItemState carries its original optional output pointer through parents and writes it only for SET. Complete PropertyAttribute IDL constants include both REMOVABLE/REMOVEABLE. Real Writer tab/bool/break/default graph tests preserve MAYBEVOID/stale enum output and ignore-known-value rejection (WRITER450-451/CALC-517-518). Actual OOXML720-twip settings distance1270 mm100 is applied through native item/set/SwDoc.SetDefault APIs; generic document default1134 twips/2000 mm100 is unchanged. This is a kernel prerequisite, not full SwXTextDefaults/property-info/static-map/filter/UI wiring; no broad default/service/ABI/parity promotion.
